name: Read Aloud!
tagline: A natural-voice reader for pages, PDFs, ebooks, email, and whatever is on screen
description: Point it at your screen, a browser page, a PDF, an ebook, or your inbox and it reads the text in a voice that sounds human. Choose a full read, a single chapter, or a summary, with translation along the way and descriptions of images and charts.
author: ptbnat
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
